title: Style corpus (E-46 / S-183) — pack/concept-decoupled (build, pack, concept) states
description: The decoupling corpus the S-185 promotion gate re-runs. Each state is a (BUILD, PACK, CONCEPT IMAGE) triple handed to the scorer with pack and concept supplied INDEPENDENTLY (the corpus bypasses recognition, so the three axes are separable by construction). cellType enumerates the E-46 crux table; intendedFaithfulness is one rater's label (NOT human-agreement ground truth — that is S-184). cellType/subject/intendedFaithfulness membership is re-checked in the loader (one composition point: src/workshop/style-corpus.mjs), and the AC-shape coverage (4 crux types + >=2 hard-middle + >=3 subjects) is asserted there too.

rater.description: single-rater identity + date + the no-aggregation limitation

notes.description: constructibility + structural-confound + contestability disclosures (anti-hedge honest reporting)

build.description: build dir relative to repo root

concept.description: concept image the build is scored against
